question.text: Under the SEBI (Facilitation of Grievance Redressal Mechanism) (Amendment) Regulations, 2023, an AIF Manager must redress an investor grievance received through SCORES within:

answer.text: 7 calendar days from date of receipt
21 calendar days from date of receipt
15 calendar days from date of receipt
30 calendar days from date of receipt

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Ch 11.7.8 and the 2023 Amendment Regulations, AIF Managers shall redress investor grievances within 21 calendar days from the date of receipt of the grievance/complaint. The complaint and the Action Taken Report (ATR) are routed through the SCORES platform. The Trap: Options A and C use shorter day-counts that do not match the 21-day deadline in the source. Option D uses 30 days, which is outside the statutory window referenced in the workbook. Note: The keyed deadline is 21 calendar days from receipt, paired with SCORES routing of the complaint and ATR.
